verses.geez: ወነበቦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi cu Aaron şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν, λέγεν,

verses.geez: ፍልጥዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ በበሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወበበቤተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፤
verses.translation: Take the sum of the children of Caath from the midst of the sons of Levi, after their families, according to the houses of their fathers' households;

translations.lxx: Take the sum of the children of Caath from the midst of the sons of Levi, after their families, according to the houses of their fathers' households;
translations.kjv: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
translations.ron: "Numără din fiii lui Levi pe fiii lui Cahat, după neamurile şi după familiile lor, pe toţi cei buni de slujbă,
translations.grk: λάβε τὸ κεφάλαιον τῶν υἱῶν Καὰθ ἐκ μέσου υἱῶν Λευὶ, κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν, κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν,

verses.geez:
ዘእምዕሥራ ፡ ወኀምስቱ ፡ ዓም ፡ ወላዕሉ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘኀምሳ ፡ ዓም ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይበውእ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ግብረ ፡
                  ኵሉ ፡ ምግባር ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ።
verses.translation: from twenty-five years old and upward until fifty years, every one that goes in to minister, to do all the works in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: from twenty-five years old and upward until fifty years, every one that goes in to minister, to do all the works in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: De la treizeci de ani în sus până la cincizeci de ani, ca să lucreze la cortul adunării.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν καὶ ἐπάνω ἕως πεντήκοντα ἐτῶν, πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος λειτουργεῖν, ποιῆσαι πάντα τὰ ἔργα ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez: ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ዘቅዱሳን ።
verses.translation: And these are the works of the sons of Caath in the tabernacle of witness; it is most holy.

translations.lxx: And these are the works of the sons of Caath in the tabernacle of witness; it is most holy.
translations.kjv: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
translations.ron: Slujba fiilor lui Cahat la cortul adunării va fi să ducă sfânta sfintelor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ἔργα τῶν υἱῶν Καὰθ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου· ἅγιον τῶν ἁγίων.

verses.geez:
ወይበውኡ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያነሥእ ፡ ትዕይን[ት] ፡ ወያወርዱ ፡ መንጦላዕተ ፡ ዘይሴውር ፡ ወይከድንዋ ፡ ቦቱ
                  ፡ ለታቦት ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons shall go in, when the camp is about to move, and shall take down the shadowing veil, and shall cover with it the ark of the testimony.

translations.lxx: And Aaron and his sons shall go in, when the camp is about to move, and shall take down the shadowing veil, and shall cover with it the ark of the testimony.
translations.kjv: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
translations.ron: Cînd va pleca tabăra, să intre Aaron şi fii lui, să ia perdeaua despărţitoare între sfînta şi sfînta sfintelor, să învelească cu ea chivotul legii;
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσελεύσεται Ἀαρὼν καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ, ὅταν ἐξαίρῃ ἡ παρεμβολὴ, καὶ καθελοῦσι τὸ καταπέτασμα τὸ συσκιάζον, καὶ κατακαλύψουσιν ἐν αὐτῷ τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου,

verses.geez:
ወይወድዩ ፡ መልዕልቶ ፡ ክዳነ ፡ ዘማእሰ ፡ ምጺጺት ፡ ወይወድዩ ፡ መልዕልቶሙ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዘኵለንታሁ ፡ ዘደረከኖ ፡
                  ወያስተዋድድዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጻውርቲሃ ።
verses.translation: And they shall put on it a cover, even a blue skin, and put on it above a garment all of blue, and shall put the staves through the rings.

translations.lxx: And they shall put on it a cover, even a blue skin, and put on it above a garment all of blue, and shall put the staves through the rings.
translations.kjv: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
translations.ron: Să pună apoi un acoperământ de piei vinete, iar pe deasupra aceluia să arunce un înveliş de lână albastră şi să pună pârghiile la chivot.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπʼ αὐτὸ κατακάλυμμα δέρμα ὑακίνθινον, καὶ ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπʼ αὐτὴν ἱμάτιον ὅλον ὑακίνθινον ἄνωθεν, καὶ διεμβαλοῦσι τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወዲበ ፡ ማእድኒ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሥርዐት ፡ ይወድዩ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዘኵለንታሁ ፡ ዘሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ወመጻብሕቲሃኒ ፡
                  ወአጽሕልቲሃኒ ፡ ወመዳምኅተኒ ፡ ወመዋጽሕቲሃኒ ፡ በዘ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ያወጽኅ ፡ ወኅብስተኒ ፡ ዘይሠርዑ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ላዕሌሃ
                  ።
verses.translation: And they shall put on the table set forth for shew-bread a cloth all of purple, and the dishes, and the censers, and the cups, and the vessels with which one offers drink-offerings; and the continual loaves shall be upon it.

translations.lxx: And they shall put on the table set forth for shew-bread a cloth all of purple, and the dishes, and the censers, and the cups, and the vessels with which one offers drink-offerings; and the continual loaves shall be upon it.
translations.kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
translations.ron: Apoi să aştearnă pe masa pâinilor punerii înainte o fată de masă violetă şi să pună pe ea blidele, talerele, oalele şi cupele cele pentru turnat, şi pâinile ei pururea să fie pe ea.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπί τὴν τράπεζαν τὴν προκειμένην ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπʼ αὐτὴν ἱμάτιον ὁλοπόρφυρον, καὶ τὰ τρυβλία, καὶ τὰς θυΐσκας, καὶ τοὺς κυάθους, καὶ τὰ σπονδεῖα ἐν οἷς σπένδει, καὶ οἱ ἄρτοι οἳ διαπαντὸς ἐπʼ αὐτῆς ἔσονται.

verses.geez:
ወይወድዩ ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ለይ ፡ ወይከድንዋ ፡ መክዳና ፡ ዘማእሰ ፡ ምጺጺት ፡ ወያስተዋድድዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጻውርቲሃ
                  ።
verses.translation: And they shall put upon it a scarlet cloth, and they shall cover it with a blue covering of skin, and they shall put the staves into it.

translations.lxx: And they shall put upon it a scarlet cloth, and they shall cover it with a blue covering of skin, and they shall put the staves into it.
translations.kjv: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
translations.ron: Peste acestea să pună o poală purpurie, iar pe deasupra ei să pună un acoperământ de piele vânătă şi să-i pună pârghiile.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπʼ αὐτὴν ἱμάτιον κόκκινον, καὶ καλύψουσιν αὐτὴν καλύμματι δερματίνῳ ὑακινθίνῳ, καὶ διεμβαλοῦσι διʼ αὐτῆς τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥኡ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ደረከኖ ፡ ወይከድንዋ ፡ ለመራናት ፡ እንተ ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ያኃትዉ ፡ ወመኃትዊሃኒ ፡ ወጕጠታቲሃ ፡
                  ወበዘ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ያሤንይዋ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ግምዓቲሃ ፡ ዘቅብእ ፡ ዘእምውስቴቱ ፡ ይገብርዋ ።
verses.translation: And they shall take a blue covering, and cover the candlestick that gives light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its funnels, and all the vessels of oil with which they minister.

translations.lxx: And they shall take a blue covering, and cover the candlestick that gives light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its funnels, and all the vessels of oil with which they minister.
translations.kjv: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
translations.ron: Să ia apoi o îmbrăcăminte violetă şi să acopere sfeşnicul şi candelele lui, cleştele lui, plutele lui, şi toate vasele cele pentru untdelemn, care se întrebuinţează la el.
translations.grk: Καὶ λήψονται ἱμάτιον ὑακίνθινον, καὶ καλύψουσι τὴν λυχνίαν τὴν φωτίζουσαν, καὶ τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰς λαβίδας αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰς ἐπαρυστρίδας αὐτῆς, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἀγγεῖα τοῦ ἐλαίου οἷς λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወይወድይዋ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ንዋያ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መክደና ፡ ዘማእሰ ፡ ምጺጺት ፡ ወያስተዋድድዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጻውርቲሃ ።
verses.translation: And they shall put it, and all its vessels, into a blue skin cover; and they shall put it on bearers.

translations.lxx: And they shall put it, and all its vessels, into a blue skin cover; and they shall put it on bearers.
translations.kjv: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
translations.ron: Să-l acopere pe el şi toate uneltele lui cu un acoperământ de piei vinete şi să-l pună pe năsălie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμβαλοῦσιν αὐτὴν, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς, εἰς κάλυμμα δερμάτινον ὑακίνθινον, καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν αὐτὴν ἐπʼ ἀναφορέων.

verses.geez:
ወለምሥዋዕኒ ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ይገለብብዎ ፡ በልብስ ፡ ዘደረከኖ ፡ ወይከድንዎ ፡ እምላዕሉ ፡ በማእሰ ፡ ምጺጺት ፡
                  ወያስተዋድድዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጻውርቲሁ ።
verses.translation: And they shall put a blue cloth for a cover on the golden altar, and shall cover it with a blue skin cover, and put in its staves.

translations.lxx: And they shall put a blue cloth for a cover on the golden altar, and shall cover it with a blue skin cover, and put in its staves.
translations.kjv: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
translations.ron: Peste jertfelnicul cel de aur să pună o îmbrăcăminte violetă, să-l acopere cu un acoperământ de piei vinete şi apoi să-i aşeze pârghiile în verigi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν ἐπικαλύψουσιν ἱμάτιον ὑακίνθινον, καὶ καλύψουσιν αὐτὸ καλύμματι δερματίνῳ ὑακινθίνῳ, καὶ διεμβαλοῦσι τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥኡ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ግብር ፡ በዘ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ወይወድይዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብስ ፡ ዘደረከኖ ፡ ወይከድንዎ ፡
                  በማእሰ ፡ ምጺጺት ፡ ወያነብርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጻውርቲሁ ።
verses.translation: And they shall take all the instruments of service, with which they minister in the sanctuary: and shall place them in a cloth of blue, and shall cover them with blue skin covering, and put them upon staves.

translations.lxx: And they shall take all the instruments of service, with which they minister in the sanctuary: and shall place them in a cloth of blue, and shall cover them with blue skin covering, and put them upon staves.
translations.kjv: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:
translations.ron: Să ia toate lucrurile cele pentru slujbă, care se întrebuinţează la slujbă în locaşul sfânt, şi să le pună în învelişuri de lână violetă, să le acopere cu acoperăminte de piei vinete şi să le pună pe năsălie.
translations.grk: καὶ λήψονται πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ λειτουργικὰ ὅσα λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις· καὶ ἐμβαλοῦσιν εἰς ἱμάτιον ὑακίνθινον, καὶ καλύψουσιν αὐτὰ καλύμματι δερματίνῳ ὑακινθίνῳ, καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπὶ ἀναφορεῖς.

verses.geez: ወመክደነሂ ፡ ያነብርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወይከድኑ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዘሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ኵለንታሁ ።
verses.translation: And he shall put the covering on the altar, and they shall cover it with a cloth all of purple.

translations.lxx: And he shall put the covering on the altar, and they shall cover it with a cloth all of purple.
translations.kjv: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
translations.ron: După aceea să cureţe jertfelnicul de cenuşă, să-l acopere cu o îmbrăcăminte violetă,
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν καλυπτῆρα ἐπιθήσει ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ ἐπικαλύψουσιν ἐπʼ αὐτὸ ἱμάτιον ὁλοπόρφυρον.

verses.geez:
ወይወድዩ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ በዘ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ወመዓጥንተሂ ፡ ወመኋስስተኒ ፡ ወፍያላተኒ ፡
                  ወመክደኖሙ ፡ ወኵ[ሎ] ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወይ[ወድ]ዩ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ መክዳኖ ፡ ዘማእሰ ፡ ምጺጺት ፡ ወያነብርዎ ፡ ዲበ ፡
                  መጻውርቲሁ ፡ ወይነሥኡ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዘሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ወይከድንዎ ፡ ለማዕከክ ፡ ወለመከየዱ ፡ ወይወድይዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መክደኑ
                  ፡ ዘማእሰ ፡ ምጺጺት ፡ ወያነብርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጻውርቲሁ ።
verses.translation: And they shall put upon it all the vessels with which they minister upon it, and the fire-pans, and the flesh-hooks, and the cups, and the cover, and all the vessels of the altar; and they shall put on it a blue cover of skins, and shall put in its staves; and they shall take a purple cloth, and cover the laver and its foot, and they shall put it into a blue cover of skin, and put it on bars.

translations.lxx: And they shall put upon it all the vessels with which they minister upon it, and the fire-pans, and the flesh-hooks, and the cups, and the cover, and all the vessels of the altar; and they shall put on it a blue cover of skins, and shall put in its staves; and they shall take a purple cloth, and cover the laver and its foot, and they shall put it into a blue cover of skin, and put it on bars.
translations.kjv: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.
translations.ron: Să pună pe el toate vasele lui, care se întrebuinţează la el în timpul slujbei: cleştele, furculiţele, lopeţile, oalele şi toate vasele jertfelnicului, să-l acopere cu un acoperământ de piei vinete şi să-i pună pârghiile. Să ia apoi o îmbrăcăminte violetă şi să acopere baia şi postamentul ei; să pună pe deasupra lor un acoperământ vânăt de piele şi să le pună pe năsălie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπʼ αὐτὸ πάντα τὰ σκεύη ὅσοις λειτουργοῦσιν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἐν αὐτοῖς, καὶ τὰ πυρεῖα, καὶ τὰς κρεάγρας, καὶ τὰς φιάλας, καὶ τὸν καλυπτῆρα, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου· καὶ ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐπʼ αὐτὸ κάλυμμα δερμάτινον ὑακίνθινον, καὶ διεμβαλοῦσι τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς αὐτοῦ· καὶ λήψονται ἱμάτιον πορφυροῦν, καὶ συγκαλύψουσι τὸν λουτῆρα καὶ τὴν βάσιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐμβαλοῦσιν αὐτὸ εἰς κάλυμμα δερμάτινον ὑακίνθινον, καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπὶ ἀναφορεῖς,

verses.geez:
ወፈጺሞሙ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ ከዲነ ፡ ዘቅድሳት ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ዘቅድሳት ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያነሥእ ፡ ትዕይን[ት] ፡
                  ወእምዝ ፡ ይበውኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ ይትመጠዉ ፡ ወኢይገስሱ ፡ ዘቅድሳት ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይሙ[ቱ] ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘይነሥኡ ፡ ደቂቀ
                  ፡ ቃዓት ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons shall finish covering the holy things, and all the holy vessels, when the camp begins to move; and afterwards the sons of Caath shall go in to take up the furniture; but shall not touch the holy things, lest they die: these shall the sons of Caath bear in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And Aaron and his sons shall finish covering the holy things, and all the holy vessels, when the camp begins to move; and afterwards the sons of Caath shall go in to take up the furniture; but shall not touch the holy things, lest they die: these shall the sons of Caath bear in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: După aceea Aaron şi fiii lui, înainte de plecarea taberei la drum, vor strânge tot cortul şi vor înveli toate lucrurile locaşului sfânt, iar fiii lui Cahat vor veni să le ia; dar nu trebuie să se atingă ei de sfânta sfintelor, ca să nu moară. Aceste lucruri ale cortului să le ducă fiii lui Cahat.
translations.grk: καὶ συντελέσουσιν Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ, καλύπτοντες τὰ ἅγια, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια, ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν τὴν παρεμβολήν· καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσονται υἱοὶ Καὰθ αἴρειν, καὶ οὐχ ἅψονται τῶν ἁγίων, ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνωσι· ταῦτα ἀροῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Καὰθ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወሥዩም ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እልዓዛር ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህን ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ ማኅቶት ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ዕጣን ፡ ዘየዐጥኑ ፡
                  ወላዕለ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ዘኵሉ ፡ አሚር ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ዘይቀብኡ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ሥዩም ፡ ውእቱ ፡
                  ወላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ግብር ።
verses.translation: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest is overseer—the oil of the light, and the incense of composition, and the daily meat-offering and the anointing oil, are his charge; even the oversight of the whole tabernacle, and all things that are in it in the holy place, in all the works.

translations.lxx: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest is overseer—the oil of the light, and the incense of composition, and the daily meat-offering and the anointing oil, are his charge; even the oversight of the whole tabernacle, and all things that are in it in the holy place, in all the works.
translations.kjv: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
translations.ron: Eleazar, fiul preotului Aaron, va fi supraveghetor peste untdelemnul pentru sfeşnic, aromatele de tămâiat, darul zilnic de pâine şi mirul; va avea şi supraveghere peste tot cortul şi peste câte sunt în el şi în locaşul sfânt şi peste toate lucrurile".
translations.grk: Ἐπίσκοπος Ἐλεάζαρ υἱὸς Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἱερέως, τὸ ἔλαιον τοῦ φωτὸς, καὶ τὸ θυμίαμα τῆς συνθέσεως, καὶ ἡ θυσία ἡ καθʼ ἡμέραν, καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως, ἡ ἐπισκοπὴ ὅλης τῆς σκηνῆς, καὶ ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ, ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi cu Aaron şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν, λέγων,

verses.geez: ኢትሥርውዎሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ ለቃዓት ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ።
verses.translation: Ye shall not destroy the family of Caath from the tribe out of the midst of the Levites.

translations.lxx: Ye shall not destroy the family of Caath from the tribe out of the midst of the Levites.
translations.kjv: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
translations.ron: "Să nu lăsaţi să se stingă sămânţa neamului lui Cahat dintre leviţi.
translations.grk: μὴ ὀλοθρεύσητε τῆς φυλῆς τὸν δῆμον τὸν Καὰθ ἐκ μέσου τῶν Λευιτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወከመዝ ፡ ግበሩ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ወየሐይዉ ፡ ወኢይመውቱ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ለበዊኦቶሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ዘቅዱሳን ፡ አሮን ፡
                  ወደቂቁ ፡ ይባኡ ፡ ወያስተዳልዉ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ጾሮሙ ፡ ለለ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ።
verses.translation: This do ye to them, and they shall live and not die, when they approach the holy of holies: Let Aaron and his sons advance, and they shall place them each in his post for bearing.

translations.lxx: This do ye to them, and they shall live and not die, when they approach the holy of holies: Let Aaron and his sons advance, and they shall place them each in his post for bearing.
translations.kjv: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
translations.ron: Iată ce trebuie să le faceţi, ca să trăiască şi să nu moară, când se vor apropia de sfânta sfintelor: să vină Aaron şi fiii lui şi să pună pe fiecare la slujba lui şi la sarcina lui;
translations.grk: Τοῦτο ποιήσατε αὐτοῖς, καὶ ζήσονται καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνωσι, προσπορευομένων αὐτῶν πρὸς τὰ ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων· Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ προσπορεύεσθωσαν, καὶ καταστήσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἕκαστον κατὰ τὴν ἀναφορὰν αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወኢይባኡ ፡ ግብተ ፡ ይርአዩ ፡ ቅድሳተ ፡ ወይሙቱ ።
verses.translation: And so they shall by no means go in to look suddenly upon the holy things, and die.

translations.lxx: And so they shall by no means go in to look suddenly upon the holy things, and die.
translations.kjv: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
translations.ron: Dar ei să nu vină să privească la cele sfinte, când le învelesc, ca să nu moară".
translations.grk: καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθωσιν ἰδεῖν ἐξάπινα τὰ ἅγια, καὶ ἀποθανοῦνται.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez: አሐዝ ፡ ኈልቆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ እምጥንቱ ፡ በበ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፤
verses.translation: Take the sum of the children of Gedson, and these according to the houses of their lineage, according to their families.

translations.lxx: Take the sum of the children of Gedson, and these according to the houses of their lineage, according to their families.
translations.kjv: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
translations.ron: "Numără şi pe fiii lui Gherşon, pe familii şi pe neamuri, de la treizeci de ani până la cincizeci de ani;
translations.grk: λάβε τὴν ἀρχὴν τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσὼν, καὶ τούτους κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν, κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν,

verses.geez:
ዘእም፳ወ፭ዓም ፡ ወላዕሉ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘ፶ዓም ፡ ኈልቆሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘይበውእ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ግብረ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: Take the number of them from five and twenty years old and upwards until the age of fifty, every one that goes in to minister, to do his business in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: Take the number of them from five and twenty years old and upwards until the age of fifty, every one that goes in to minister, to do his business in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Şi să numeri pe toţi cei buni de slujbă, ca să lucreze la cortul adunării.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ πέντε καὶ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ἕως πεντηκονταετοῦς ἐπίσκεψαι αὐτοὺς, πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος λειτουργεῖν, ποιεῖν τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez: ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ ዘይገብሩ ፡ ወዘይጸውሩ ፤
verses.translation: This is the public service of the family of Gedson, to minister and to bear.

translations.lxx: This is the public service of the family of Gedson, to minister and to bear.
translations.kjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
translations.ron: Iată slujba familiilor lui Gherşon, adică ce au de făcut şi de dus:
translations.grk: Αὕτη ἡ λειτουργία τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Γεδσὼν, λειτουργεῖν καὶ αἴρειν.

verses.geez:
አሥቃቃተ ፡ ዘደብተራ ፡ ወደብተራሂ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወመክደና ፡ ወመክደን ፡ ዘምጺጺት ፡ ዘዲቤሃ ፡ ዘእምላዕሉ ፡ ወመክደን
                  ፡ ዘኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፤
verses.translation: And they shall bear the skins of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of witness, and its veil, and the blue cover that was on it above, and the cover of the door of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And they shall bear the skins of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of witness, and its veil, and the blue cover that was on it above, and the cover of the door of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
translations.ron: Să ducă acoperişurile cortului, cortul adunării, acoperişul lui, acoperişul cel de piei vinete, care e pe deasupra lor, perdeaua, care se atârnă la uşa cortului adunării,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀρεῖ τὰς δέῤῥεις τῆς σκηνῆς, καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ τὸ κάλυμμα αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ κατακάλυμμα τὸ ὑακίνθινον τὸ ὂν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς ἄνωθεν, καὶ τὸ κάλυμμα τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου,

verses.geez:
ወአልባሰ ፡ ዐጸድኒ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወፈድፋዳተኒ ፡ ወኵ[ሎ] ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ወኵ[ሎ] ፡ በዘ ፡
                  ቦቱ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ወይገብሩ ።
verses.translation: And all the curtains of the court which were upon the tabernacle of witness, and the appendages, and all the vessels of service that they minister with they shall attend to.

translations.lxx: And all the curtains of the court which were upon the tabernacle of witness, and the appendages, and all the vessels of service that they minister with they shall attend to.
translations.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
translations.ron: Perdeaua de la poarta curţii, pânzele curţii celei dimprejurul cortului şi a jertfelnicului, frânghiile lor şi toate lucrurile lor de slujbă şi tot ce este de făcut la ele să facă ei.
translations.grk: καὶ τὰ ἱστία τῆς αὐλῆς, ὅσα ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ τὰ περισσὰ, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ λειτουργικὰ ὅσα λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς ποιήσουσι.

verses.geez:
በከመ ፡ አዘዝዎሙ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡
                  ግብሮሙ ፡ ወኈ[ል]ቆሙ ፡ በበ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዘይጸውሩ ፡ እሙንቱ ።
verses.translation: According to the direction of Aaron and his sons shall be the ministry of the sons of Gedson, in all their ministries, and in all their works; and thou shalt take account of them by name in all things borne by them.

translations.lxx: According to the direction of Aaron and his sons shall be the ministry of the sons of Gedson, in all their ministries, and in all their works; and thou shalt take account of them by name in all things borne by them.
translations.kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
translations.ron: Toate slujbele fiilor lui Gherşon la ducerea poverilor şi la toate lucrările lor trebuie să se facă după porunca lui Aaron şi a fiilor lui şi lor să le încredinţaţi spre păstrare tot ceea ce au ei de dus.
translations.grk: Κατὰ στόμα Ἀαρὼν καὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ἔσται ἡ λειτουργία τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσὼν κατὰ πάσας τὰς λειτουργίας αὐτῶν, καὶ κατὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐπισκέψῃ αὐτοὺς ἐξ ὀνόματος πάντα τὰ ἀρτὰ ὑπʼ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወሊቆሙ ፡ ይታመር ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሮን
                  ፡ ካህን ።
verses.translation: This is the service of the sons of Gedson in the tabernacle of witness, and their charge by the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

translations.lxx: This is the service of the sons of Gedson in the tabernacle of witness, and their charge by the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.ron: Acestea sunt slujbele fiilor lui Gherşon la cortul adunării şi acestea li se vor încredinţa spre păstrare sub. supravegherea lui Itamar, fiul preotului Aaron.
translations.grk: Αὕτη ἡ λειτουργία τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσὼν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ ἡ φυλακὴ αὐτῶν ἐν χειρὶ Ἰθάμαρ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἱερέως.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ ሜራሪኒ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ኈልቆሙ ፤
verses.translation: The sons of Merari according to their families, according to the houses of their lineage, take ye the number of them.

translations.lxx: The sons of Merari according to their families, according to the houses of their lineage, take ye the number of them.
translations.kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
translations.ron: Pe fiii lui Merari, iar să-i numeri, după neamurile şi după familiile lor,
translations.grk: Οἱ υἱοὶ Μεραρὶ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν, κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν, ἐπισκέψασθε αὐτοὺς,

verses.geez:
ዘእም ፡ ፳ወ፭ዓም ፡ ወላዕሉ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘ፶ዓም ፡ ኈልቆሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይበውእ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ግብረ ፡ ደብተራ
                  ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: Take the number of them from five and twenty years old and upwards until fifty years old, every one that goes in to perform the services of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: Take the number of them from five and twenty years old and upwards until fifty years old, every one that goes in to perform the services of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: De la treizeci de ani în sus până la cincizeci de ani. Să numeri pe toţi cei buni de slujbă, ca să lucreze la cortul adunării.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ πέντε καὶ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ἕως πεντηκονταετοῦς ἐπισκέψασθε αὐτοὺς, πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος λειτουργεῖν τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ፡ ዘይጸውሩ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ አርእስቲሃ ፡
                  ለደብተራ ፡ ወመናስግቲሃ ፡ ወአዕማዲሃ ፡ ወመካይዲሆን ፡ ወመካድንተ ፡ ወመናብርቲሆሙ ፡ ወአዕማዲሆሙ ፡ ወመንጦላዕተ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡
                  ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፤
verses.translation: And these are the charges of the things borne by them according to all their works in the tabernacle of witness: they shall bear the chapiters of the tabernacle, and the bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and the veil, and there shall be their sockets, and their pillars, and the curtain of the door of the tabernacle.

translations.lxx: And these are the charges of the things borne by them according to all their works in the tabernacle of witness: they shall bear the chapiters of the tabernacle, and the bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and the veil, and there shall be their sockets, and their pillars, and the curtain of the door of the tabernacle.
translations.kjv: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
translations.ron: Iată ce să ducă ei, după slujba lor la cortul adunării: scândurile cortului cu pârghiile lor, stâlpii lui cu postamentele lor, funiile cortului cu ţăruşii lor;
translations.grk: Καὶ ταῦτα τὰ φυλάγματα τῶν αἰρομένων ὑπʼ αὐτῶν κατὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου· τὰς κεφαλίδας τῆς σκηνῆς, καὶ τοὺς μοχλοὺς, καὶ τοὺς στύλους αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰς βάσεις αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ κατακάλυμμα, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ στύλοι αὐτῶν, καὶ τὸ κατακάλυμμα τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς,

verses.geez:
ወአዕማደ ፡ አውደ ፡ ዐጸድ ፡ ወመካይዲሆን ፡ ወመታክሊሆን ፡ ወመታግርቲሆን ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ንዋዮን ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ንዋየ ፡
                  ግብሮሙ ፤ በበአስማቲሆሙ ፡ ትኌልቆሙ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ፡ ዘይጸውሩ ፡ እሙንቱ ።
verses.translation: And they shall bear the pillars of the court round about, and there shall be their sockets, and they shall bear the pillars of the veil of the door of the court, and their sockets and their pins, and their cords, and all their furniture, and all their instruments of service: take ye their number by name, and all the articles of the charge of the things borne by them.

translations.lxx: And they shall bear the pillars of the court round about, and there shall be their sockets, and they shall bear the pillars of the veil of the door of the court, and their sockets and their pins, and their cords, and all their furniture, and all their instruments of service: take ye their number by name, and all the articles of the charge of the things borne by them.
translations.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
translations.ron: Stâlpii curţii de pe toate laturile ei cu postamentele lor, ţăruşii curţii cu frânghiile lor, toate uneltele lor şi tot ce ţine de ele. Să număraţi pe nume toate lucrurile ce sunt datori să ducă.
translations.grk: καὶ τοὺς στύλους τῆς αὐλῆς κύκλῳ, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν, καὶ τοὺς στύλους τοῦ καταπετάσματος τῆς πύλης τῆς αὐλῆς, καὶ τὰς βάσεις αὐτῶν, καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους αὐτῶν, καὶ τοὺς κάλους αὐτῶν, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῶν, καὶ πάντα τὰ λειτουργήματα αὐτῶν· ἐξ ὀνομάτων ἐπισκέψασθε αὐτοὺς, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς φυλακῆς τῶν αἰρομένων ὑπʼ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሜራሪ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወእሙንቱኒ
                  ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ይታመር ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህን ።
verses.translation: This is the ministration of the family of the sons of Merari in all their works in the tabernacle of witness, by the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

translations.lxx: This is the ministration of the family of the sons of Merari in all their works in the tabernacle of witness, by the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.ron: Aceasta-i slujba neamului fiilor lui Merari şi tot ce au să facă la cortul adunării, sub supravegherea lui Itamar, fiul preotului Aaron".
translations.grk: Αὕτη ἡ λειτουργία δήμου υἱῶν Μεραρὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν χειρὶ Ἰθάμαρ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἱερέως.

verses.geez:
ወኈለቍዎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ወመላእክቲሆሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ አብያተ ፡
                  አበዊሆሙ ፤
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel took the number of the sons of Caath according to their families, according to the houses of their lineage;

translations.lxx: And Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel took the number of the sons of Caath according to their families, according to the houses of their lineage;
translations.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
translations.ron: Atunci au numărat Moise şi Aaron cu căpeteniile obştii pe fiii lui Cahat după neamurile şi după familiile lor,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπεσκέψατο Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες Ἰσραὴλ τοὺς υἱοὺς Καὰθ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν, κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν,

verses.geez:
ዘእም፳ወ፭ዓም ፡ ወላዕሉ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘ፶ዓም ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይበውእ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ደብተራ
                  ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: from five and twenty years old and upwards to the age of fifty years, every one that goes in to minister and do service in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: from five and twenty years old and upwards to the age of fifty years, every one that goes in to minister and do service in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
translations.ron: De la treizeci de ani în sus până la cincizeci de ani, pe toţi cei buni de slujbă, ea să lucreze la cortul adunării.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ πέντε καὶ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ἕως πεντηκονταετοῦς, πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος λειτουργεῖν καὶ ποιεῖν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez: ወኮነ ፡ ኍለቊሆሙ ፡ ዘበበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ፳፻፯፻፶ ።
verses.translation: And the numbering of them according to their families was two thousand, seven hundred and fifty.

translations.lxx: And the numbering of them according to their families was two thousand, seven hundred and fifty.
translations.kjv: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
translations.ron: Şi s-au găsit la numărătoare, după familiile lor, două mii şapte sute cincizeci.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν, δισχίλιοι ἑπτακόσιοι πεντήκοντα.

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኍለቊሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ይበውኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡
                  በከመ ፡ ኈለቍዎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወበእደ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: This is the numbering of the family of Caath, every one that ministers in the tabernacle of witness, as Moses and Aaron numbered them by the word of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.

translations.lxx: This is the numbering of the family of Caath, every one that ministers in the tabernacle of witness, as Moses and Aaron numbered them by the word of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.
translations.kjv: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Acesta este numărul fiilor lui Cahat, toţi cei buni de slujbă la cortul adunării, pe care i-au numărat Moise şi Aaron, după porunca Domnului, dată prin Moise.
translations.grk: Αὕτη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις δήμου Καάθ, πᾶς ὁ λειτουργῶν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καθὰ ἐπεσκέψατο Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν διὰ φωνῆς Κυρίου, ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ.

verses.geez: ወኈለቍዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፤

ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኍለቊሆሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸውሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡

translations.grk: ἀπὸ πέντε καὶ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ἕως πεντηκονταετοῦς, πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος λειτουργεῖν πρὸς τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez: ወኮነ ፡ ኍለቊሆሙ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ፴፻፪፻ ።
verses.translation: And the numbering of them according to their families, according to the houses of their lineage, was three thousand and two hundred.

translations.lxx: And the numbering of them according to their families, according to the houses of their lineage, was three thousand and two hundred.
translations.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
translations.ron: Şi s-au găsit la numărătoare, după neamul lor şi după familii, trei mii două sute.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν, κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν, τρισχίλιοι καὶ διακόσιοι.

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኍለቊሆሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሜራሪ ፡ እለ ፡ ኈለቍዎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ወበእደ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: This is the numbering of the family of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered by the word of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.

translations.lxx: This is the numbering of the family of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered by the word of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.
translations.kjv: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Acesta este numărul fiilor lui Merari, pe care i-au numărat Moise şi Aaron, după porunca Domnului, dată prin Moise.
translations.grk: Αὕτη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις δήμου υἱῶν Μεραρὶ, οὓς ἐπεσκέψατο Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν διὰ φωνῆς Κυρίου, ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ እለ ፡ ኈለቍዎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ወመላእክቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡
                  በበሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፤
verses.translation: All that were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel numbered, namely, the Levites, according to their families and according to the houses of their lineage,

translations.lxx: All that were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel numbered, namely, the Levites, according to their families and according to the houses of their lineage,
translations.kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
translations.ron: Toţi leviţii, număraţi de Moise şi de Aaron şi de căpeteniile lui Israel, după neamurile şi după familiile lor,
translations.grk: Πάντες οἱ ἐπεσκεμμένοι, οὓς ἐπεσκέψατο Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες Ἰσραὴλ τοὺς Λευίτας, κατὰ δήμους καὶ κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν,

verses.geez:
ዘእም፳ወ፭ዓም ፡ ወላዕሉ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘ፶ዓም ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ምግባረ ፡ ግብር ፡
                  ዘይጸውሩ ፡ ዘደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፤
verses.translation: from five and twenty years old and upward till fifty years old, every one that goes in to the service of the works, and the charge of the things that are carried in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: from five and twenty years old and upward till fifty years old, every one that goes in to the service of the works, and the charge of the things that are carried in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
translations.ron: De la treizeci de ani în sus, până la cincizeci de ani, toţi cei buni de slujbă, ca să lucreze la cortul adunării şi să-l ducă,
translations.grk: ἀπὸ πέντε καὶ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ἕως πεντηκονταετοῦς, πᾶς ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος πρὸς τὸ ἔργον τῶν ἔργων, καὶ τὰ ἔργα τὰ αἰρόμενα ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez: ኮኑ ፡ እለ ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ፹፻[፭]፻፹ ።
verses.translation: And they that were numbered were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.

translations.lxx: And they that were numbered were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
translations.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
translations.ron: S-au găsit la numărătoare opt mii cinci sute optzeci.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθησαν οἱ ἐπισκεπέντες, ὀκτακισχίλιοι πεντακόσιοι ὀγδοήκοντα.

verses.geez:
በቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ተኈለቁ ፡ ለለ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ በበ ፡ ምግባሪሆሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ ጾሮሙ ፡ ወተኈለቁ ፡ በከመ ፡
                  አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: He reviewed them by the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses, appointing each man severally over their respective work, and over their burdens; and they were numbered, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: He reviewed them by the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses, appointing each man severally over their respective work, and over their burdens; and they were numbered, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Şi după porunca Domnului, dată prin Moise, s-au rânduit fiecare la lucrul său şi la slujba sa, şi au fost număraţi, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Διὰ φωνῆς Κυρίου ἐπεσκέψατο αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ, ἄνδρα κατὰ ἄνδρα ἐπὶ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ ὧν αἴρουσιν αὐτοί· καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.
